title: Dispatch: odpc long-rest spell preparation (Sonnet 5.5, attempt 1)
description:
Implementation plan for parent eshyra-odpc (read `bd show eshyra-odpc` for scope and acceptance criteria). Supervisor decisions below are made; STOP and report in notes if the code contradicts a premise.

WORKTREE/BRANCH: .worktrees/eshyra-odpc.1 on branch eshyra-odpc.1 (cut from origin/main d9be4acb). Run `npm ci` there first.

FILE BOUNDARY: a parallel task is editing levelUpEngine.ts, levelUpFeatureChoices.ts and docs/design/character-progression.md. Do NOT edit those three files. Document in module header comments and in docs/design/srd-level-up-row-classification.md only if relevant; otherwise a concise section in the protocol/tool description is enough.

CODE SURVEY
- packages/core/src/character/levelUpSpells.ts: prepareDescriptor() (~line 1021) computes the prepared-spell option set and limit at level-up: class spellPreparation.preparationFormula {ability, classLevelDivisor, minimum}, the class's 'prepared-spells' feature choice (baseChoice) whose `from` is a spellFilter (parseSpellFilter / evaluateSpellFilter; wizard filter uses mustBeInSpellbook; castable levels only), limit = max(minimum, mod + floor(level/divisor)). Also effectiveSpellcasting() (legacy flat-list classification), spellsUnion(), applySpellPlacements().
- packages/core/src/character/finalizeCharacter.ts: CharacterSpellcasting {cantrips, known?, spellbook?, prepared?, mysticArcanum?, designations?} + its validator; CharacterSheet.spells is the derived union; CharacterFeatureChoice.
- packages/core/src/character/characterSheetStore.ts: createSqliteCharacterSheetStore(db).load/save (shares the db transaction).
- packages/core/src/state/rest.ts: rest_event(campaign_id, rest_id, kind, start/end_elapsed_minutes, status ...) + rest_participant; spendRestHitDie() (~line 749) is the precedent for a post-rest window: completed rest, participant, and clock(txn).elapsedMinutes === end_elapsed_minutes (window closes when world time advances).
- packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolRest.ts, tools.ts (registry), protocol.ts (model guidance), toolSpendUsage.ts (character resolution pattern).
- Pack: class:cleric/druid/wizard/paladin data.spellPreparation (kind 'prepared', formulas as in the bead AC). subclass records carry data.spellTableRefs -> table records whose data.projection {kind 'subclassSpellGrants', rows:[{level, spells:[spell NAMES]}]} (life-domain-spells, oath-of-devotion-spells by class level; circle-of-the-land-<terrain> x7; fiend-expanded-spells is warlock = NOT always-prepared, out of scope). resolver.resolveSpell(nameOrRef) maps names to spell records.
- Circle of the Land land pick persists on CharacterSheet.featureChoices as {featureRef:'feature:circle-of-the-land:circle-spells', choiceId:'land', optionIds:['land:<terrain>'], level:3}.

DECISIONS
1. Core operation in a new module (e.g. packages/core/src/character/spellPreparation.ts): prepareSpellsAfterLongRest(db, {characterId, restId, spellRefs, resolver?, ...audit fields as the rest tools use}) inside withTransaction. Exposed to the model as a new tool `prepare_spells` (orchestrator/toolPrepareSpells.ts, registered in tools.ts, one concise protocol.ts line). Export from internal.ts only (not the root index).
2. Gate (SRD: "You can change your list of prepared spells when you finish a long rest"): restId must be a completed LONG rest whose participants include the character, and the world clock must still equal that rest's end_elapsed_minutes (same window rule as spendRestHitDie). Repeated calls inside the window replace the list (last wins). Preparation time is treated as part of finishing the rest; say so in the doc comment.
3. Eligibility: sole-class prepared casters only (class spellPreparation.kind 'prepared' with a preparationFormula: cleric, druid, paladin, wizard). Known casters, non-casters and paladin below the level where the class has slots/the prepared-spells choice: refuse with a clear reason. Reuse assertSupportedCharacterBuild.
4. One implementation for option set + limit: refactor prepareDescriptor's computation into an exported helper in levelUpSpells.ts used by both level-up and the new operation (no duplicated formula). Limit uses the sheet's current ability score and class level. Accept 1..limit distinct refs, each in the option set (wizard: only spellbook spells). Unknown ref, duplicate, over-limit, out-of-set -> reject, no write.
5. Always-prepared: add an optional `alwaysPrepared?: readonly string[]` bucket to CharacterSpellcasting (validator + spellsUnion). Recompute it on every preparation from the pack: sheet.subclass -> subclass spellTableRefs -> subclassSpellGrants rows with level <= class level -> resolveSpell (unresolvable name = fail closed, never guessed). Circle of the Land: use only the table matching the recorded land pick; if no land pick is recorded, set no circle spells and return an explicit `alwaysPreparedUnresolved` reason in the result (preparation itself still succeeds). Only cleric/druid/paladin subclass tables apply. These spells do not count against the limit; a selected ref that is already always-prepared is rejected with a reason. Recomputation at level-up and at creation is NOT in scope: file a follow-up bead (bd create, label srd, discovered-from eshyra-odpc) for level-up/creation to refresh alwaysPrepared.
6. Legacy sheets without sheet.spellcasting: classify with effectiveSpellcasting as level-up does; if classification fails, refuse with its reason. Persist sheet.spellcasting.prepared + alwaysPrepared and the derived sheet.spells union via the sheet store in the same transaction. No progression-ledger event (ledger kinds are xp/milestone/level-up only).
7. No change to completeLongRest/rest engine behavior, slot recovery, or cast-time checks.

EVIDENCE (real generated pack; concise tests)
- Cleric prepares after a completed long rest within the window; correct limit (WIS mod + level); over-limit rejected; Life Domain spells present in alwaysPrepared, not counted, and selecting one rejected.
- Window/gate: clock advanced past rest end -> rejected; short rest -> rejected; non-participant -> rejected.
- Wizard: only spellbook spells accepted. Paladin: CHA mod + floor(level/2), minimum 1.
- Circle of the Land druid with a land pick gets that land's circle spells up to its level; without a pick, explicit unresolved reason.
- Known caster (e.g. sorcerer) refused.
- Tool wiring: one test through the tool's run() (args validation + success path).
- Level-up prepare descriptor behaviour unchanged (existing tests stay green).

PROTOCOL: run `npm run verify:worktree` from the worktree root BEFORE committing (it rewrites files); commit on eshyra-odpc.1; append a completion report with `bd update eshyra-odpc.1 --append-notes` (changes, decisions, tests, verify result, follow-up bead ids); `bd close eshyra-odpc.1`.
notes: Completed on branch eshyra-odpc.1, commit 3ab53d8f. New prepare_spells tool + prepareSpellsAfterLongRest (character/spellPreparation.ts, internal.ts export only). Gate: completed long rest, participant, clock == end_elapsed_minutes; last call wins. Shared evaluatePreparationBasis helper in levelUpSpells.ts used by level-up prepareDescriptor and the new op. alwaysPrepared bucket added to CharacterSpellcasting (validator, spellsUnion, preserved by applySpellPlacements); resolver gained resolveSubclassSpellTables. Circle of the Land: recorded land only, else alwaysPreparedUnresolved. Tests: test/spellPreparation.test.ts (11); tools.test.ts name list updated. verify:worktree green (6091 pass). Follow-up: eshyra-kn38 (refresh alwaysPrepared at level-up/creation).
